methodology.heroSubtitle: A transparent look at the machine-learning pipeline behind FarmKonnect's market outlook.
methodology.stepsTitle: From mandi data to your forecast
methodology.step1Desc: We use daily AMIS Punjab mandi prices going back to 2009 — over 15 years of history across commodities, varieties and cities.
methodology.step2Desc: Prices are resampled into weekly series with lags, rolling averages, momentum and seasonality so the models can learn real market patterns.
methodology.step3Desc: LightGBM models are trained per commodity, alongside quantile models for ranges and a persistence baseline as a safety net.
methodology.step4Desc: For every commodity and horizon, a router automatically picks the model that performed best in historical backtests.
methodology.step5Desc: Quantile models output a likely high–low band (q10–q90), so you see a realistic range — not just a single guess.
methodology.step6Desc: A rolling accuracy score (MAPE) is tracked every week, and drift in performance raises alerts automatically.
methodology.step7Desc: Models retrain every month on the freshest data so forecasts keep up with changing market conditions.
methodology.readForecastDesc: The model's predicted price for the weeks ahead.
methodology.readBandDesc: The likely range the price could fall within — wider means more uncertainty.
methodology.readErrorDesc: How far off the model typically is, based on recent accuracy tracking.
methodology.disclaimerBody: These forecasts are data-driven estimates to help you plan — not financial guarantees. Markets can move suddenly due to weather, policy or supply shocks. Always combine forecasts with your own judgement.
methodology.ctaSubtitle: Explore live price trends and forecasts on your dashboard.

about.title: About FarmKonnect
about.subtitle: Pakistan's first AI-powered agricultural marketplace
about.heroDesc: FarmKonnect is Pakistan's leading digital agricultural marketplace, connecting farmers directly with buyers and providing real-time market intelligence to maximize profits.
about.missionText: To empower Pakistani farmers by giving them direct access to buyers, eliminating middlemen, and providing AI-driven market insights to maximize their income.
about.missionP1: We believe that every farmer deserves access to fair prices, transparent markets, and modern technology. FarmKonnect was born from the idea that by connecting farmers directly with buyers, we can eliminate middlemen and ensure farmers receive the true value of their hard work.
about.missionP2: Our platform provides real-time market prices, AI-powered price predictions, and a secure marketplace where farmers can list their produce and connect with buyers across Pakistan.
about.visionText: A future where every farmer in Pakistan has the tools and information they need to make informed business decisions and thrive in a fair market.
about.valuesDesc: These core principles guide everything we do at FarmKonnect.
about.val1Desc: Every decision we make prioritizes the welfare and success of Pakistani farmers.
about.val2Desc: Building trust through transparent pricing, secure transactions, and honest dealings.
about.val3Desc: Promoting sustainable farming practices for a greener future.
about.val4Desc: Leveraging technology to solve age-old agricultural challenges.
about.ctaDesc: Start selling your produce directly to buyers and get the best prices for your hard work.
about.transparencyDesc: Real prices, real reviews, real connections.
